This project addresses forecasting challenges outlined by Shift Digital, 
including highly seasonal business behavior and sparse store-level data. 
Our goal is to improve forecasting accuracy across different business types 
and deliver a pattern-specific modeling pipeline that reduces error and 
improves stability across diverse retail environments.

## Goals
- Demand pattern segmentation  
- Pattern-specific forecasting  
- Multi-metric evaluation  
- Robust error analysis  
- Practical recommendations for retail and marketing planning  

## Key Findings

- No single model performs best for all series.
- Croston dominates intermittent demand.
- SARIMA is most reliable for regular and seasonal demand.
- Prophet underperforms due to limited seasonal depth.
- Pattern-based modeling improves accuracy by ~25–35%.
